query.description: Device Layer 추가 (같은 키가 있으면 건너뜀 / PLACED FK 대상이라 먼저 저장)
query.commandtext: INSERT INTO TQP_GDS_LAYER (FACTORY, DEVICE_ID, LAYER_ID, COLOR_ARGB, DISPLAY_NAME) SELECT :factory, :device_id, :layer_id, :color_argb, :display_name FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TQP_GDS_LAYER WHERE FACTORY = :chk_factory AND DEVICE_ID = :chk_device_id AND LAYER_ID = :chk_layer_id)

query.description: 조회 화면: Device Layer 목록 + Layer별 배치 도형 수 / 좌표 수 (2026-10-02 CLAUDE-018 키 FACTORY + DEVICE_ID)
query.commandtext: SELECT L.LAYER_ID, L.COLOR_ARGB, L.DISPLAY_NAME, NVL(P.PLACED_COUNT, 0) AS PLACED_COUNT, NVL(P.POINT_COUNT, 0) AS POINT_COUNT FROM TQP_GDS_LAYER L LEFT JOIN (SELECT LAYER_ID, COUNT(*) AS PLACED_COUNT, SUM(POINT_COUNT) AS POINT_COUNT FROM TQP_GDS_PLACED_EL WHERE FACTORY = :placed_factory AND DEVICE_ID = :placed_device_id GROUP BY LAYER_ID) P ON P.LAYER_ID = L.LAYER_ID WHERE L.FACTORY = :factory AND L.DEVICE_ID = :device_id ORDER BY L.LAYER_ID
